scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=@wrs/server & npm run dev --workspace=@wrs/client
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@wrs/shared && npm run build --workspace=@wrs/server && npm run build --workspace=@wrs/client
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit --workspace=@wrs/server && npm run test:unit --workspace=@wrs/shared
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:security && npm run build
scripts.verify:full: npm run verify && npm run test:e2e
